notes: ACCESS: reached DIRECTLY with plain urllib + a desktop Chrome UA (HTTP 200 on every request, no proxy, no impersonation, no bot challenge), exactly as the prior Furniture pass recorded. robots.txt fetched FIRST: it is the current Shopify 'agentic' robots file. It names NO anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude directive; the only group is 'User-agent: *' with 'Allow: /' and a header comment stating 'Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart and localized HTML is crawlable'. Disallowed paths are /admin, /cart/, /checkout, /checkouts/, /orders, /account, /services, /sf_*, /cart.js, /recommendations/products and /collections/*sort_by* facet traps - none of which were used. The file also advertises agents.md, /.well-known/ucp and a UCP/MCP endpoint and asks agents not to complete checkout; no transactional endpoint was touched. TREE: read from the store's OWN mega-menu in the homepage HTML (ul.nav__list > ul.nav__sublist > ul.nav__subsublist), which is a true 3-level tree on this store. The complete top level is: Furniture (Living Room / Dining Room / Bedroom / Office / Outdoor Furniture sub-departments), Sofas, Chairs, Tables, Bedroom, Storage, Decor, Room Ideas, What's New. Every single sub- and sub-sub node was enumerated (85 category links in total). There is NO Bath / Bathroom / Bath Accessories / Vanities / Sanitaryware / Showers / Basins / Taps node anywhere in the navigation, at any level. COMPLETENESS CHECK BEYOND THE NAV (rule 34 - absence from the nav is not proof): the full published collection universe was enumerated from the store's own sitemap (sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml, 327 collection URLs). Grepping all 327 handles for bath|bathroom|vanit|towel|shower|soap|sink|toilet|bidet|basin|tub|mirror returned exactly ONE hit: /collections/mirrors, which is the Decor > Mirrors node (470 products) - general decorative wall and floor mirrors sold under Decor, with no bathroom/vanity-mirror child collection, so it belongs to the Mirrors/Decor category and not to Bathroom (rules 11 and 29). Direct URL probes for the obvious handles all returned HTTP 404: /collections/bath, /collections/bathroom, /collections/bath-accessories, /collections/vanities, /collections/bathroom-vanities, /collections/powder-room, /collections/towels. PRODUCTS EXIST BUT NO CATEGORY DOES: all 33 product sitemaps were pulled (25,140 product URLs) and grepped; the store does stock a handful of bathroom-intended SKUs - Four Hands Elliston / Everett / Millie single and double VANITIES, Anthem BATH STORAGE, and four 'bath and vanity' wall fixtures. Their product JSON was read: e.g. elliston-double-vanity-satin-worn-oak-by-four-hands has product_type 'Furniture - Storage' and tag 'cabinets', i.e. the store files them under Storage > Cabinets (/collections/cabinets, 400 products), and their JSON-LD BreadcrumbList is only Home > with no category node. There is therefore no Bathroom category, sub-category or listing page to record. Per rules 27 and 36 no URL was invented and no row was fabricated. QTY: not applicable - zero Bathroom listings. For reference, the rendered header this store uses is N products (verified live on /collections/mirrors = 470 products and /collections/cabinets = 400 products), the same source the prior Furniture pass proved by paging products.json to exhaustion. EXCLUDED and why: Decor > Mirrors (470) - general decor mirrors, primary type mirror but not a bathroom/vanity mirror node, no bathroom hierarchy (rules 11, 21, 29). Storage > Cabinets (400) - general storage cabinets that happen to contain a few Four Hands bath vanities; site hierarchy is Storage, so it stays in Storage (rules 9, 12, 30-33) and must not be re-cut as Bathroom. Decor > Bedding, Decor > Tabletop, Decor > Lighting - not bathroom nodes. Bedroom > Vanities does not exist on this store (the 'vanity desk' SKUs are dressing tables, furniture, and there is no vanity collection).
